notes.title: Steam Next Fest - demo CyberTown!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

🎉We are pleased to inform you that our game is taking part in Steam NEXT FESTIVAL! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33826020/3701284c5809e1c6618bca7086857999b3ea48ef.png[/img]

⏰ 08.02.2023 at 11:00CET Join a unique live stream to see how developers and community managers play in the DEMO version of our game! On the livestream we will talk about the game and present various gameplay features. We'll also share some tricks and tips for you! :)

Our team wanted to thank you for your warm welcome of our game. We really enjoy reading all your surveys and comments on our Steam Page, we do our best to answer all your questions.


 [b]CyberTown[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1535520/CyberTown/


If for some reason you have not checked out our Demo yet, be sure to do so. Demo contains just several buildings and mechanics that will be available in the full release, we will be showcasing more about the laters stages of the game gameplay in the upcoming Devlogs, so be sure to add our game to wishlist ro not miss any new info regarding our game.

Once again, thank you for an amazing response, our team is extremely happy that you all finally had a chance to play our game after many months of hard work. Remember to fill out the survey once you finish the game and also leave us comments in the Steam Discussion Page. You can also hop by our livestream to come and chat with our team.


Best,
GamePlanet

notes.title: Devlog #18
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️In the previous devlog , we wrote about rendering characters.

⭐️You can read about it here - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/2968422316514195992]Devlog #17[/url]

⭐️In today's devlog, we'll focus on the procedural visual degeneration of furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/f914517b59a7f77bee5d5c86feee7976d807b97c.png[/img]

⭐️First, our beloved red couch. As you can see, frequent use will lead to visible damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/0637b4abab8149425b8cafc40356845f3f82c21f.gif[/img]


⭐️Cheap garden chairs will not last long. We must be aware that quality will also affect the speed of degradation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/fec9ba7bd52e00cd65adf0815a9382bc272a8c1d.gif[/img]

⭐️As you can see, metal is also influenced by time and conditions. We need to plan our budget to have funds for the replacement or repair of devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/69b7276eeeebfa56f4820136862da9e36aabf515.gif[/img]

⭐️Ultimately, not only furniture and devices deteriorate ... Be careful that no cucumber falls under the cupboard, because you can forget about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/ac255d4fc287a038ef79a941788a32aebe363112.gif[/img]


⭐️How do you like the changes to character rendering?

⭐️We invite you to our discord where you can share them -[url=https://discord.com/invite/jQnsk3AhJ7] LINK![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #17
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️In the previous devlog , we wrote about the skills that allow us to properly equip a restaurant.

⭐️You can read about it here - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/2978554218303775263]Devlog #16[/url]

⭐️In today's devlog, we'll focus on rendering characters.

⭐️Before we focused on this aspect, the characters looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/5f325b076b94fe78905710eb1c76eef3ae02428a.gif[/img]

⭐️However, the characters themselves are more cartoonish than the rest of the game and also have some shadows already painted on the texture, this can be seen when all shading is turned off:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/6fde93fe04ee4f01111112b8fe8a21f5e134c547.gif[/img]

⭐️See the difference under the chin and eyes?


⭐️These characters look pretty good without shading, but they lose some depth, so maybe let's add some shading, but make it cartoonish as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/986c4d8e536a2cc1cb08be14c07acace8904c089.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/3654c404a208c87b635f10df174be545941f5e61.gif[/img]

⭐️The depth is back, but we can still emphasize it by adding underlining the illuminated side:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/de7fd915d4e01c87101aad415fcf78f675e58ef5.gif[/img]


⭐️Characters shaded in this way emphasize the contrast between themselves and the realistic surroundings, which can give the impression of a miniature and compliment the environment itself

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/2411e928e65edb7fe2f963a98330976dad152bb2.gif[/img]

⭐️How do you like the changes to character rendering?

⭐️We invite you to our discord where you can share them - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #16
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️In the previous devlog , we wrote about removing stains and dirt in our restaurant.

⭐️You can read about it here - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/2984182379491622428]Devlog #15[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/abfa66bc07b6c5e34197facd4cb0fa1ca30b20ab.png[/img]


⭐️In today's devlog, we will tell you more about the skills that allow us to properly equip a restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/78f6d64e7cac0c699b629018524e31d0d6200fc4.gif[/img]

⭐️Above you can see visualizations of the space that can be walked by guests / npc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/6c5bf4f3713c4ea1ffe401b9e4e12e80b889944c.gif[/img]

⭐️It reacts to the objects placed, thanks to which it is possible to analyze on an ongoing basis whether it is possible to reach the selected object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/6a79c005f561bc8dc90ba0b36da6d5aab8ca5603.png[/img]

⭐️Here is a screen of both functions working - highlighting interactive objects and visualization of available surfaces for guests to navigate.

⭐️We must wisely manage the space so that our guests do not get stuck in the aisles or can freely walk to the bathroom.



⭐️How do you like the new feature?

⭐️We invite you to our discord where you can share them - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #15
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️In the previous devlog, we wrote about waffle iron model!

⭐️In today's devlog, we will focus on removing stains and dirt in our restaurant.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/ad6b0e1209ecb0572380c18f7529b0626ae36bd0.png[/img]

⭐️Dirty stains in a restaurant are extremely common. After all, wherever you work, there must be side effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/e13d1932881a29c2473105a0e8c56053b462b933.gif[/img]


⭐️Depending on the amount of dirt, stains can take different colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/47e3ff98f52d33cea93578ff9eaba57677c3e6b2.gif[/img]


⭐️Our goal is, of course, to get rid of dirt.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/da9eac24e670cd744b9447741572ee74f3aa0d47.gif[/img]


⭐️The easiest way to implement is to simply cut a mask on some gradient


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/add6d1de62bbc23a6a7452b0eaa723bc341ba2f8.gif[/img]

⭐️However, we don't like to do the simplest ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/51521b39fd5a2f5850719dc376132608fc64f204.gif[/img]

⭐️Let's throw in a little bit of noise.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/0d64ced5ddea7690fb2750be75ac6b268f73f74d.gif[/img]


⭐️Stains do not disappear by themselves - you need the right tool!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/58d4f6575e3c65593991258082bdbaa012fcbeec.gif[/img]


⭐️To make it more natural, you need to make sure that the mop does not remove the entire stain at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/7c9292d88c66182d350f52291b25d2b9e583e5d0.gif[/img]


⭐️Now it's okay - dirt is removed naturally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/4390be788e5496b5b8de44f5245eff2f35961ae5.gif[/img]


⭐️We will try to remove our logo from the floor - don't do it at home!




⭐️How do you like the operation of our mop?

⭐️We invite you to our discord where you can share them - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK!
[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #14
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️In the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/2983053941894679717]devlog[/url], we wrote about a new set of furniture in a unique style!

⭐️In today's devlog, we will focus on our waffle iron model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/5eba0b81ea1f189fa6a77a43c890f11b41ce0389.jpg[/img]

⭐️As a model, we used equipment from our own kitchen. As you can see, it is pink, so we wanted to duplicate this aspect as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/e64d89e7ef2257d54a671fce48986bfabaf7a322.png[/img]

⭐️At the beginning, the model itself, which does not have many details yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/0d016b4b008372453aff59c880fb7ef68723d460.png[/img]

⭐️Then smoothing the surface and previewing the model without the mesh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/340f5d1e9a4397c3062d7713bc27191e718118f5.png[/img]

⭐️Here you can see what the interior looks like. You want to make a waffle right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/84b0422d89e6587abdf721602e5796392c8e90f7.gif[/img]

⭐️What are we missing? Of course, the most important element - a beautiful pink color!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/675db31b39e75f9c2e31b455891dbed034c5ca00.png[/img]

⭐️Be sure to let us know what you think about our wonderful pink waffle iron!



⭐️We invite you to our discord where you can share them - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #13
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️In the last devlog we showed the game and interaction menu and we showed the juicy effect.

⭐️Today we will show what you like the most - a new collection of furniture for our restaurant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/a2aaa9e87dc9f6d984319ba3b9247ac49529773d.png[/img]

⭐️We hope you like themed restaurants too, because we have prepared something amazing for you!

⭐️Comfortable furniture? Here you are! How would you fold out the armchairs and the couch to make your guests satisfied?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/9c4c9f8462f0dd8d7ac82da08189404f22536058.png[/img]

⭐️What if you add a tasteful screen to separate your guests and give them some privacy?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/7703ba8c0a72614d12192cdb5c01af94bd806e57.png[/img]

⭐️Candles can come in handy in the evening when we dim the lights in the restaurant. They will add some charm and slightly increase the mysterious mood :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/ea8dae5aad2d4f9370a46442068d81d15f989342.png[/img]

⭐️We can also put larger tables in the restaurant, which will be useful when the whole family decides to eat a festive dinner with us.


⭐️We are looking forward to your comments! Maybe you have any ideas what kind of furniture can be found in our restaurant? We invite you to our discord where you can share them - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #11
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️In the last devlog we wrote about the scanner and its usefulness in the renovation of our restaurant.


⭐️In today's devlog, we will tell you about a special skill that our character has!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/ecf5fdcb4e301fa74729c430540d5758d5e29575.png[/img]


⭐️In our restoration, a lot of things require our attention. To make it easier for you, we decided to introduce a special skill that allows you to mark items with which we can interact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/14afcfba3fd5564e0c2770af3d2895de3cf775e5.png[/img]


⭐️Depending on the stage of development of our restaurant, other things will require our attention. Our task will be to clean the restaurant and some rubbish is difficult to see. Now it will be easier.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/59cfded403a162c824dafb62053ccced9c8f7080.gif[/img]


⭐️The new skill will also make it easier for us to control the stock level. We must not run out of ingredients when the restaurant is full of guests.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/c48bd9d55b8d1da9389131893c46c76180d687f0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #10 - Scanner
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️In the last devlog we wrote about the renovation of walls.


⭐️This time we will focus on the scanner for selling things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/741e8a592b43549c2fbc97392586c0bf7dfc892f.gif[/img]


⭐️Very often we will have a limited budget to refurbish our restaurant. However, there will be a lot of equipment in the room that does not fully match our vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/88daca7aba5133c352683df802fb67ce4aafd132.png[/img]


⭐️Red chairs will not quite match if we dream of an elegant place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/0724eb7c2ccbe905cc4182ab40586efde88b5750.png[/img]



⭐️In this case, it is best to sell the redundant equipment and get additional funds yourself.



⭐️You decide what is worth leaving and what is best to get rid of as soon as possible!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/3c75538806957404171c5e6d0ee825066f7187d9.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️In the last devlog we wrote about various possibilities of decorating our interior.

⭐️This time we will focus on the renovation of the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/7a4a74495b8d4e4534e58304db02b0c46c8d1a81.gif[/img]

⭐️Walls can be procedurally generated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/5ccd3763734598b1dbf98c9cda5cdb8dfe44463d.gif[/img]

⭐️The player decides for himself what the walls in the renovated restaurant will look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/247f8b4207d7662c37fc6b2e27d3db1272d18f29.gif[/img]


⭐️The animation of the wall construction is based on shader magic, thanks to which the game will be well-optimized and will not burden the CPU as much.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/d3ab5b16e7c06321a8795bd272b7232789dbe505.png[/img]

⭐️Of course, we need tools for renovation! Write in the comment which tool you think is the most useful when renovating a restaurant!



⭐️We would also like to invite everyone to our Discord where we will be happy to answer all your questions about the current work - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8 - Furniture themes
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️We have recently been working on a new interior design for our restaurant. We hope you will find today's devlog very interesting!

⭐️After renovating our dream restaurant and preparing the walls and floors, we will also have to equip it properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/19f791a87780aca75402dde0840132904da1cad7.png[/img]

⭐️You can already associate this scene above with our social media, but this time we will show you some more options for decor with furniture from the 50s!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/32ff6328799cb31b91b49eb4b25f04cc1e681b42.png[/img]

⭐️Of course, when we talk about the 1950s, we cannot ignore the vinyl records and red upholstery in restaurants, which could be easily found in small towns and on highway rides in the United States.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/6a29aea0f786b8919829399f98e7f3da20b7194a.png[/img]


⭐️Known especially from old movies, the red checkered handkerchiefs, which you can see on the table, add to the atmosphere of our restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/11dd45c397393b8a5efa97bb60b5a7348f785fbc.png[/img]


⭐️You will decide for yourself how your restaurant should look like. We plan to add much more themed furniture and you can see the next proposal below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/cfffb874a5df630d2f75f5d8b1b2abb733b047f8.png[/img]


⭐️It will be a great option for fans of travel and restaurants in this climate.



⭐️We would also like to invite everyone to our Discord where we will be happy to answer all your questions about the current work - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Ingredients
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳

⭐️Another devlog ahead of you. This time we will show you how important are the dishes and what they consist of.


⭐️Running a restaurant is not only about renovations, but also about creating great dishes for our guests! It is also known that the best dishes need the best ingredients!


⭐️First, you have to buy ingredients to fill the shelves in the restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/7773be3604763c6c3a20022aa2a658fbfe60c908.gif[/img]

⭐️The ingredients must be of the best quality! We also have to be careful not to let go of the jar because cleaning is waiting for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/2d73071c1a06cc028bbd595027e7b97d1624ee86.gif[/img]


⭐️Sometimes you get a faulty batch, which will reduce the quality of the dishes in our restaurant!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/05f6b7f804170d975732ac0f37b3d54aeab64816.gif[/img]


⭐️In this case, we can safely throw away the jar, but we still have to clean it up!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/f524d36b0ca27839e7550bc32c9f7ca4c7665b9a.gif[/img]

⭐️Did you like our story? Another devlog in two weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/d50d4a1dff0f397f70bf663f07e2ce814711c139.png[/img]

⭐️We would also like to invite everyone to our Discord where we will be happy to answer all your questions about the current work - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Reviews
notes.content:
Hello renovators!👩‍🍳


⭐️We have a lot of work to do, but we haven't forgotten you! 
In the last two weeks, we have continued to work on the models and the different situations they can find themselves in.

⭐️We decided to show you a hypothetical situation when we discover that our restaurant received unflattering reviews.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/075775d389de37bc60de309aec5290274ab3ee65.gif[/img]


⭐️As you can see, the received reviews can serve as hints on what can be improved in the appearance of our restaurant.


⭐️However, there is always another way:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/9276521082cd9b329289aca78135bc516c46145d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/97d6c9c4085fbb076a97b4963cff0635f98fd4fc.gif[/img]


⭐️The effects in both situations will be similar! 
And they will bring the intended effect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/3c3098faae7444c7a7a319241e3efa7f5433a981.gif[/img]


⭐️The opinions about our restaurant have returned to the appropriate level and we can enjoy five stars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/03a148d815ec58b9c9c99e7dcf254e729703c1f5.png[/img]


⭐️We would also like to invite everyone to our Discord where we will be happy to answer all your questions about the current work - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]DISCORD[/url]
